# A loop whose trip count is a constant below the break-even, 8 elements (or 4 full
# vectors for a reduction), is left alone: the scalar loop is faster than the vector
# loop and the dispatch around it. The same loops with a larger or an unknown count
# are rewritten.

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

loopvec -split .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Short(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 2; i < 8; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func Four(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func ShortSum(a []int32) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Eight(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func LongSum(a []int32) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Unknown(a, b []float32, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 3 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func Short(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 2; i < 8; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func Four(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func ShortSum(a []int32) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Eight(a, b []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

func LongSum(a []int32) int32 {
	var s int32
	for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func Unknown(a, b []float32, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		a[i] += b[i]
	}
}

{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":10,"func":"Four","vectorized":false,"reason":"constant trip count is too small for the vector loop to pay off","stage":"plan"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":17,"func":"ShortSum","vectorized":false,"reason":"constant trip count is too small for the vector loop to pay off","stage":"plan"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":24,"func":"Eight","vectorized":true}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":31,"func":"LongSum","vectorized":true}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":38,"func":"Unknown","vectorized":true}
